summary: Iter162 - Event Map independent races (gare) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest tests/test_eventmap_races.py 13/13 PASSED (155s, 3 real 15s renders). Covered: create race 403 addon_required before activation; single legacy track -> GET auto-creates one race named from GPX (idempotent on repeated GET); GPX sha256 dedupe returns the existing track with duplicate:true and no new DB row; 3 races (Maratona/Mezza/Christmas) each with its own title/subtitle/date/distance_km/track/style/format/duration/speed/music/show_aid/show_elevation; editing one leaves the others unchanged and partial PUT keeps other fields; validation (bad style/duration -> 400, impossible date -> 422, distance 0 -> 422, blank name -> 400, track from another event -> 400, unknown race -> 404); copy-from copies only the 8 video settings, never name/title/subtitle/date/distance/track, and self-copy gives 400; race preview returns JPEG, and race without track gives 400 for both preview and video; race video stores race_id/race_name/title/subtitle/distance_display_m=42195/date/version; second generation is v2 and v1 is kept; addon_usage.videos_used goes up only after completion (+1 each), and races/previews use no credits; download Content-Disposition 'event-map-Maratona-16x9-15s.mp4' and '-v2.mp4'; legacy POST /events/{eid}/videos still renders; DELETE race keeps tracks and videos (race_label stays 'Maratona', file still served); multi-track event without races lists unassigned_tracks, from-tracks creates one race per track (idempotent), no GPX duplication. Logo regression check: tests/test_eventmap_logo.py preview white-ratio asserts failed (0.076 vs 0.020+0.1). I rendered the same job with the previous commit's eventmap_render.py (39424ce) and the current one: the outputs are PIXEL-IDENTICAL in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 (ImageChops diff bbox None) when subtitle/distance are not set. So this is a stale test threshold, not a regression. Frontend (Playwright 1920 + 390 mobile, TEST_ org): the unassigned banner shows for 2 GPX and 'Crea schede gara dai GPX' creates 2 races; Nuova gara dialog creates a race ('senza GPX', Anteprima disabled); title/subtitle/date/distance/format/duration/style autosave ('Modifiche salvate'); switching races right after an edit (before the 700ms debounce) flushes the change; values persist after reload; selector label updates to '42,195 km'; Duplica impostazioni dialog copies the settings; Modifica gara is prefilled and renames; date and distance reset links work; preview image renders; Genera video, then the archive label 'Maratona 42,195 km – Video 16:9 – 15 secondi'; Scarica MP4 gives filename event-map-Maratona-16x9-15s.mp4; player opens; the archive filter works per race; Rigenera from another selected race switches to Maratona with the video settings, and the next generation shows '· v2' while v1 stays; uploading a duplicate GPX shows the toast 'File già presente: uso «Maratona.gpx»' and assigns the existing track with no new track; deleting a race via the confirm keeps tracks and videos; no horizontal overflow on mobile.

minor.issue: 'eventmap_races' is missing from ORG_CASCADE_COLLECTIONS, so deleting an org leaves orphan eventmap_races docs (6 were left after my pytest org was deleted; I removed them by org_id). Fix: add 'eventmap_races' to the list.

On an event with exactly 1 track, if the user deletes the only race, the next GET re-creates it automatically (named after the GPX), so the delete looks like it did nothing. Also, two concurrent first GETs can create two auto races (no upsert or lock). Consider marking that the auto race was created (e.g. eventmap_settings.races_initialized=true) and creating it only once, with an atomic upsert.

Sending explicit null for style/format/duration/speed gives 400 'Impostazioni video non valide': the validity check runs before the code that drops null keys. The frontend never sends null for these, so impact is low.

When race.date is null, the video uses the event data_inizio and ignores the older event-level eventmap_settings.date. New races copy the settings date when created, so this only affects races whose date was reset. Probably intended ('Usa la data dell'evento'), but worth confirming.

issues: em-race-date uses the browser's native <input type=date>: the Chrome en-US locale shows mm/dd/yyyy in an Italian UI. Consider the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.

The preview image is in the right column at the top and is not sticky: after clicking Anteprima at the bottom of the long form (1920x1080), the result is off-screen and the user must scroll up. Make the preview column sticky (lg:sticky lg:top-4) or scroll to it.

On first visit the 'Scopri CRMEvent con una demo gratuita' dialog and the cookie banner (in English, 'We respect your privacy') cover the studio. Not part of this feature, but the cookie banner defaults to EN for an Italian UI.

action_items: Add 'eventmap_races' to ORG_CASCADE_COLLECTIONS in server.py so org deletion purges races
Make the single-track auto-race one-time and atomic, so a deleted single race does not come back and concurrent GETs cannot create duplicates

Update the stale threshold in tests/test_eventmap_logo.py::test_preview_with_and_without_logo (wa > wb + 0.1 now gives 0.076 vs 0.02: the render is pixel-identical to the previous commit, so lower it to about +0.04 or compare against the logo box). Update tests/test_eventmap_video.py to activate Event Map before uploading GPX
Optional: replace the native date input with the shadcn date picker; make the preview panel sticky
critical_code_review_comments: eventmap.py event_state writes to the DB (auto-creates a race) inside a GET: a side effect on read, with no idempotency guard against concurrent requests.

race_video version = count of all videos for that race_id + 1, which includes errored jobs. A failed v2 means the next successful one is labelled v3. Acceptable, but consider counting only non-error videos.

copy_race does not re-validate the source logo id. It is safe because it is the same event, but if that logo was deleted the target race inherits a dangling logo id, and the video request then returns 404 'Logo non trovato'.

Frontend regen() loads only the video settings (style/format/...) into the race, not title/subtitle/date/distance, which matches the spec ('rigenera' with the current race data). The upload of a duplicate GPX re-assigns the existing track to the current race (good, no duplication).
EventMapStudio flush() on unmount is fire-and-forget. Fine, but an error toast may appear after navigating away.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new race tests); legacy test_eventmap_logo.py 14/17 - 3 failures are a stale threshold, render verified pixel-identical to the previous commit
